lp.title: Landing pages
lp.sub: Pages for one product with an order box inside, made for ads. Orders carry the page they came from.
lp.off: Landing pages are switched off: customers see none of them until you switch them on in the card below. You can still build and publish.
lp.emptySub: One product, one offer, an order box on the page — made for ads.

card.d: While it is off the shop shows no landing page to customers. Search engines never list them.
card.on: Show published landing pages to customers
card.readOnly: You can see this but not change it.

b.headline: Headline
b.partsSub: Switch parts on or off; their order is fixed for the best results.
b.wordsSub: Your own words. Prices always come from the product itself.
b.benefits: Why this product — one reason per line
b.benefitsBn: The same reasons in Bengali, one per line
b.timerHelp: The countdown hides itself after this time.
b.previewSub: A sketch of the parts that are on, in their order.
b.publishConfirm: Publish now — customers can open it
b.readOnly: You can see this page but not change it.

err.STALE: Someone changed this page meanwhile. It was read again — check and save once more.
err.SLUG_TAKEN: That link is already used by another page.
err.PRODUCT_OFF: The product is not on sale, so the page cannot be published.
err.WRONG_STATE: That step does not fit the page's state now.
err.ARCHIVED: An archived page is restored before it is changed.
err.forbidden: You do not have permission for this.
err.NAME_TAKEN: Another template already has that name.

t.title: Templates
t.sub: Ready-made sets of parts and your own, to start a landing page from. The parts library says what each part shows.
t.readySub: Layouts only: which parts are on. The words are yours and the prices are always the product's own.
t.yoursSub: Saved from the builder with their parts and words. A page made from one keeps its own copy.
t.none: None yet. In the builder open More options and choose Save as a template.
t.librarySub: The eight parts every landing page is made of, always in this order.
t.startSub: Picking one fills the parts and words below. You can change everything after.
t.blankNote: All parts on except the countdown, no words yet
t.saveName: Save these parts as a template — its name
t.saveHelp: Keeps the switches and words on screen (not the countdown's end). This page itself does not change.

offer-first.name: Offer first
offer-first.note: The offer and order box near the top, then photos, size chart and reviews. For people who just saw the ad.

fit-first.name: Fit & size first
fit-first.note: Size chart and fit reviews before the offer. Fewer exchanges.

story.name: Story & fabric
story.note: Photos and why this product, then the order box. For premium styles.

combo-push.name: Combo push
combo-push.note: Photos, reviews and the order box for a set or pack offer.

hero.shows: The headline, your offer line and the main photo
hero.from: Your headline and offer line; the product's first photo

gallery.shows: The product's photos, colour by colour

benefits.shows: The reasons to buy, one per line
benefits.from: Your own words in the builder

size.shows: The size chart, and the try-on line when the shop offers it
size.from: The product's size chart; the checkout and product page settings

form.shows: Colour, size and the order button, with the live price
form.from: The product's live prices and stock

faq.shows: Cash on delivery, delivery and exchange answers
faq.from: The shop's own delivery, exchange and returns rules

timer.shows: A countdown to the offer's end; it hides itself after
timer.from: The end time set on each page
